cognodb.label: CognoDB Cloud (c0)
cognodb.notes: The assignment brief states 256 MB; the vendor's own pricing page states 512 MB. Re-verify in the console and record what the instance actually reports. Cloud-only - no self-hosted image is documented, so there is no track-B twin. Ships no vector search and no graph algorithms (vendor's developer page), so no workload may depend on GDS-style procedures.
